description: Pins INSIDE the stream-mcp image (infra-ik4p.1): the MCP package, supergateway, npm itself and the node base. Runs from mdapi/fleet's `renovate` job, which lists this repo in RENOVATE_REPOSITORIES. The readers (Dockerfile FROM + the `# renovate:` ARG regex), the house core, OSV alerts and the dependency-proxy alias come from the shared preset local>mdapi/renovate-config:image-repo; do not set enabledManagers or postUpgradeTasks here, since a repo value REPLACES the preset's. MR-only: a merge here pushes :latest, and mdapi/fleet's digest MR for evertrust-mcp/stream-mcp.yml can merge without a person, so nothing in this repo automerges.
